top_stories.title: China-Linked Hackers Exploited BeyondTrust Zero-Day to Take Over Remote Support Servers
top_stories.summary: A China-linked cyber espionage group (Armory Castle/UNC5221) exploited a critical zero-day vulnerability (CVE-2026-102764, CVSS 9.3) in BeyondTrust Remote Support servers in late August 2026. The flaw involves improper origin validation in an internal messaging component and allowed attackers to take over Remote Support servers.

top_stories.title: Workday to Acquire C1.ai, a Leading Agentic Identity Platform for People and Agents
top_stories.summary: Workday announced its acquisition of C1.ai, described as an agentic identity platform managing access for both human users and AI agents throughout their lifecycle. The deal, announced at Workday Rising 2026, positions Workday to integrate identity governance capabilities covering provisioning and deprovisioning for people and AI agents directly into its platform.

top_stories.title: BeyondTrust patches zero-day exploited in attacks since August
top_stories.summary: BeyondTrust disclosed a critical zero-day vulnerability in its Remote Support product that has been actively exploited in attacks since late August. The flaw required an emergency patch and affects BeyondTrust's privileged access management and remote support infrastructure.

top_stories.title: CISA Urges Immediate Ivanti Connect Secure Updates as Honeypots Log 105 Exploit Attempts
top_stories.summary: CISA is urging organizations to immediately update Ivanti Connect Secure appliances following active exploitation of CVE-2026-104935, an authentication bypass vulnerability with a CVSS score of 8.6. Honeypots have recorded 105 exploit attempts against the flaw, which affects the ICS remote access VPN product.

top_stories.title: Golden SAML, Explained: One Stolen Key, Unlimited Accepted Identities
top_stories.summary: The article explains the Golden SAML attack technique, which involves stealing signing keys from Active Directory Federation Services (AD FS) to forge authentication tokens that are accepted as legitimate credentials. It covers the role of the DKM container in protecting signing keys and examines the scope and limitations of Microsoft's October hardening measures addressing this attack vector.

news.title: Why Active Directory weaknesses stay open for years in teams with one or two admins
news.summary: An interview with intcube CTO David Fuhr details a 12-week security cohort where 27 municipalities hardened Windows Server and Active Directory together. The program covered security settings including SMB signing, LDAP signing, and Kerberos hardening, with lab testing and measurements taken at the start and end of the cohort.

news.title: ServiceNow gives AI agents a passport, and limits on what they can do
news.summary: ServiceNow announced AI Passport, an authority layer that provides runtime control over what AI agents and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers are authorized to do within multi-agent workflows. The solution combines runtime governance, platform integration, and oversight to manage AI agent authorization and access permissions in enterprise environments.

news.title: GhostAction Compromises About 1,900 GitHub Accounts, Targets Over 30,000 Repositories
news.summary: A credential-theft campaign called GhostAction compromised approximately 1,900 GitHub accounts and targeted over 30,000 repositories across 3,000 users and organizations. The attack, observed on October 8-9, 2026, attempted to extract 3,174 secrets from public repositories' CI environments, according to GitGuardian researchers.

news.title: Ivanti ICS Zero-Day Attacks Highlight Vendor Patching Hurdles
news.summary: A high-severity zero-day vulnerability (CVE-2026-104935) affecting Ivanti ICS combines authentication bypass and remote code execution, and was only partially discovered and patched in July. The incomplete patch left a window for threat actors to exploit the authentication bypass flaw, highlighting challenges in vendor vulnerability remediation.

news.title: Anthropic 'SneakPeek' Flaw Is a Silent Zero-Click Threat
news.summary: A vulnerability dubbed "SneakPeek" in Anthropic's Claude Code Desktop application allows attackers to steal credentials silently via the preview pane without any user interaction. Affected credentials include SSH private keys, AWS credentials, and Claude OAuth tokens, making it a zero-click credential theft risk for developers.

news.title: Microsoft Disrupts 3 Phishing Kits Linked to Over 1 Billion Scam Messages
news.summary: Microsoft and partners disrupted three phishing kits—CoGUI, Haozi, and Iron Man System—linked to over 1 billion scam messages since January 2026. The operation involved Health-ISAC, Japan's JC3, and private sector companies including Cloudflare, Oracle, and Proofpoint.

news.title: How to Run a Deepfake Readiness Drill Before a Cloned Voice Calls Your Team
news.summary: The article outlines a structured drill methodology for security teams to test their verification processes against deepfake-based social engineering attacks targeting help desk resets and access requests. The drill is designed to identify weaknesses in identity verification workflows before real cloned voice or synthetic video attacks exploit them.

news.title: An AI Agent Found a Critical OTP Bypass in Production. The Attack Was the Easy Part.
news.summary: An AI pentesting agent discovered a critical OTP (one-time passcode) bypass vulnerability during an authorized assessment of a major insurer's production website. The flaw allowed users to specify where their one-time passcode was sent, effectively enabling authentication bypass.

news.title: Four-Byte Write and Timing Bug Let Researchers Run Code in Windows SmartScreen Enclave
news.summary: Security researchers demonstrated a proof-of-concept exploit combining a four-byte write vulnerability and a timing bug to execute code inside a Windows VBS enclave used by the SmartScreen anti-phishing feature. The targeted enclave handles passwords, making it a protected memory region designed to remain secure even under full system compromise.

news.title: Employees Built the Agents. Enterprises Just Bought the Supervisors.
news.summary: The article examines a growing divide between company-deployed AI agents managed through identity governance platforms like Okta and employee-built or adopted AI tools operating outside official IT controls. The piece addresses how this split creates new challenges for identity governance and access management of non-human identities in enterprise environments.

news.title: The hidden network: Inside the phishing infrastructure ecosystem powering global cybercrime
news.summary: Microsoft uncovered a Chinese-language cybercriminal ecosystem involving phishing kit operators (Storm-2990) and an illicit marketplace (Storm-3119) selling tools and infrastructure for large-scale phishing attacks. The operation targets credential theft at scale, directly impacting identity security and authentication systems used by organizations globally.

news.title: Semperis 2026 Ransomware Report Reveals Increases in AI-Driven Attacks and a Rise in Physical Threats Against Executives and Their Families
news.summary: Semperis released its 2026 Ransomware Report, highlighting increases in AI-driven attacks targeting identity systems alongside rising physical threats against executives and their families. The report identifies that attacks on identity systems are outpacing recovery readiness, with repeat ransomware attacks also on the rise.

news.title: Workday Signs C1 Ai Deal to Govern People and Agents - El-Balad.com
news.summary: Workday signed a definitive agreement to acquire C1 AI on October 13, 2026, targeting governance of access for both human users and AI agents. The deal focuses on identity and access governance capabilities spanning people and agentic AI within Workday's platform.

news.title: Zero-Days Lurk in Microsoft's Overgrown October Patch Tuesday
news.summary: Microsoft's October Patch Tuesday, described as the largest security update ever, includes zero-day vulnerabilities with security defense bypasses and unauthenticated remote code execution flaws. The update is relevant to IAM environments as defense bypasses and unauthenticated RCEs can undermine authentication and access control mechanisms in Microsoft infrastructure.

news.title: No Identity, No Recovery: Cyber Resilience Starts With IAM
news.summary: The article argues that cyber resilience strategies must prioritize identity and access management, given the proliferation of enterprise applications and reliance on cloud identity providers. The piece focuses on the need to rethink identity security as a foundational component of organizational recovery.

news.title: Microsoft Plugs Nearly 1,000 Security Holes
news.summary: Microsoft released a record-breaking patch batch addressing at least 974 security vulnerabilities across Windows and other software. AI is being credited for accelerating vulnerability discovery, though security teams are reportedly struggling to keep up with testing and deploying the volume of fixes.

news.title: FBI Probes Service Selling 153M+ Drivers Licenses
news.summary: A dark web service has listed digital scans of over 153 million U.S. and Canadian driver's licenses for sale, allegedly sourced from a Louisiana-based identity verification company. The FBI's New Orleans field office has opened an official inquiry into the breach of the identity verification provider.
